title: cohniella binotii
intro: Cohniella binotii, commonly known as the Mexican prickly poppy, is a plant species within the family Papaveraceae. The Mexican prickly poppy has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to alleviate pain and promote wound healing.
